summary: Service frontend in namespace demo is experiencing high latency (P95 ~2.3s) due to a configuration error where it attempts to connect to the backend on the wrong port (9899 instead of 9898).

root_cause.explanation: The deployment was updated in revision 12, changing the --backend-url argument from port 9898 to 9899, which is causing request timeouts/cancellations as seen in the application logs.

evidence.fact: Template diff shows revision 12 changed '--backend-url=http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9898/echo' to '--backend-url=http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo'
Logs show multiple 'backend call failed' errors with 'context canceled' when calling 'http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo'
The 95th percentile latency is measured at 2.29 seconds, well above the 500ms threshold

impact: Users of the frontend service are experiencing delays of over 2 seconds per request, likely resulting in failed or extremely slow page loads.

next_steps.action: Roll back the frontend deployment to the previous known-good revision (11).
Verify the current backend service configuration to confirm the correct listening port.
